verdict.rationale: Zulip offers bots/integrations that react to messages and webhooks, which provide a basic event-triggered automation substrate, but there is no evidence of a native rule-builder or 'if-this-then-that' automation engine for defining custom trigger-action rules directly in Zulip. missing for 10: native no-code rule/trigger builder, documented event-condition-action automation framework, evidence of AI-native rule definition beyond generic bot/webhook API.
